description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:547-552: `build_with_aia` returns a chain that already passed pkix_path::validate_path (build_first_valid_path's contract per pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:1004-1006 — it yields the FIRST candidate that validate_path accepted). The slow path at line 549 then re-runs validate_path on the same chain to obtain the ValidatedPath. This re-runs every signature verification, every name-constraint check, every policy check redundantly. For a chain with 3 RSA-4096 intermediates, that's ~3 superfluous signature verifications per slow-path validation. Mitigation options: (1) have build_first_valid_path return both the chain AND the ValidatedPath it produced internally (changes pkix-path-builder API), or (2) augment build_with_aia to return the ValidatedPath alongside the chain, with an internal validate_path call that's the only one. Option (1) is the cleaner design because it eliminates the duplication at the source. Note: fast path is correct — single validate_path call.
title: Slow path validates the same chain twice (inside build_first_valid_path, then again)
